# Lacuna Digital

> Lacuna Digital is the independent practice of Dave Kelly — an AI-powered product designer and digital consultant based in North County Dublin, helping SMEs ship smarter websites, apps, and digital operations.

Lacuna Digital pairs hands-on product design (UX, UI, design systems, branding) with AI-assisted build workflows so small and mid-sized businesses can move from idea to shipped product in weeks, not months. Service pillars cover Online Visibility (web design, SEO, content) and Business Efficiency (AI integration, internal tooling, workflow automation).
